data: BEGINNING OF CONVERSATION: USER: I have never helped a person where long term it paid off, so why should I ever help someone if it doesn't benefit me? ASSISTANT:

Helping someone in need is an act of kindness and should be done for its own sake, regardless of whether or not it will benefit you in the long run. Helping someone can bring a sense of fulfillment and satisfaction, even if it does not result in a material reward. Giving to others can also lead to positive feelings, improved mental health, and stronger relationships. Ultimately, the decision to help another person should be based on your own values and beliefs, not on a potential return.
